subject: how to output all from scanone?

messages.author: 16a8a0aa155464b2
messages.subject: how to output all from scanone?
parts:
With an idea of presenting LODs (or LRS) across the genome as a heatmap for all phenotypes, I'm interested in outputting ALL values from scanone without any statistical threshold. It may seem foolish to want to output all SNPs for all phenotypes, but it would feed directly into a heat map. My attempts have been fruitless. Can you advise on how to output all? Thank you. 

out.i <- scanone(sug, pheno.col = i, model="np")

operm <- scanone(sug, pheno.col = i, model="np", n.perm=1000) 

#for statistical threshold outputs:
summary(out.i, perms=operm, alpha = .05, pvalues=TRUE) 

#failed attempts to output all
summary(out.i, perms=operm, alpha = 1, pvalues=TRUE) 
summary(out.i, perms=operm, pvalues=TRUE)

parts:
Hi,

as.data.frame(out) will give you the lod score for all your markers
